A person with long dark hair wearing a red top is visible on the right, holding a bubble wand. The background features a brick building, a statue, and street elements, all slightly distorted by the bubble's refraction.

The thickness of the bubble film at the very edge varies inconsistently; in some areas, the 'rim' appears as a solid opaque line rather than a thin film edge, which is physically unlikely for a large soap bubble.
